run_yelp_polarity_preprocessing: run the YelpPolarity module to generate k-shot train dev and test splits for multiple seeds
create_yelp_polarity_dataset: create a YelpPolarity classification dataset instance with negative and positive label mappings
load_yelp_polarity_hf_dataset: load the yelp_polarity HuggingFace dataset using the load_dataset method
map_hf_dataset_to_list: map a HuggingFace dataset split to a list of text and label tuples
split_train_test_lines: split the YelpPolarity dataset into train and test lines using a 20 percent test ratio
